title: The ALMA Detection of Extraplanar <SUP>13</SUP>CO in a Ram-pressure-stripped Galaxy and Its Implication
question: Is molecular gas (12CO and 13CO) in the ram-pressure-stripped Virgo galaxy NGC 4522 stripped from the disk or formed in situ, and what does extraplanar 13CO imply for chemical enrichment of halo gas and the ICM?

data.sensitivity: 1.44 mJy/beam (12CO) and 0.46 mJy/beam (13CO) per 5 km/s channel

what.value: Single-dish 12CO and HI masses used for extraplanar fractions and flux comparison

evidence.quote: using data from (cite: chung09) and (cite: vollmer08).

external_data.citation: Chung et al. 2009 (cite: chung09); Vollmer et al. 2008 (cite: vollmer08)

recipe.method: ALMA pipeline calibration in CASA, natural weighting, primary beam correction; intensity maps from 10 km/s cube with AIPS smoothing mask

recipe.goal: Measure clump velocity, width and flux
recipe.method: Fit single 1D Gaussian to each clump spectrum; 2D Gaussian for orientation
L'CO from Solomon et al. 1997 equation, then multiply by alpha_CO
assumptions: alpha_CO = 3.2 Msun pc-2 (K km/s)-1, no helium; distance 16 Mpc; 12CO(2-1)/(1-0) ~0.8 for single-dish comparison

recipe.method: Line ratio map, mean ratio per structure, for clumps detected at 5 sigma in both lines

recipe.goal: Compare timescales for origin of clumps
recipe.method: Compare stripping timescale (~100 Myr upper limit) with H2 and cloud formation timescales

answer_key.quantity: Fraction of CO flux in clumps

evidence.quote: about 8% of the total CO flux has been detected in clumps
The H$_{2}$ mass of clumps ranges from $10^{5}$ $M_{\odot}$ to $3 \times 10^{6}$ $M_{\odot}$
with a mean of 2388 km s$^{-1}$

not_stated_but_needed: Mask/threshold criteria for the AIPS smoothing mask and clump definitions
Cell size, image size, deconvolution and clean threshold
Whether the two pointings were mosaicked and how
Flux calibrator and flux scale uncertainty
How region apertures for clumps were defined
Procedure for line ratio map (convolution to common beam, cutoff)
Observed frequency/redshift used in the L'CO equation
missing_for_reproduction: Imaging parameters (cell, size, mask, clean threshold)
score_reason: Data are identifiable and calibration and weighting are given, but imaging and region-definition details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: The project code is given and main results are tabulated numbers, but recipe details are thin.
